messages.author: 17e30776ec2a7fb1
messages.subject: install_local
parts: I have packages "A" and "B" in the current directory. "A" depends on "B" and also on "C" where "C" is on CRAN.  install_local("A") will install "A" and also automatically installs "C" but not "B".   Is there any facility in devtools to enable it to pull in "B" automatically too if only told about "A"?

messages.author: b756a7daa2c2aa6d
messages.subject: Re: install_local
parts:
Hi Gabor,

I think you sent this to the wrong mailing list, but the answer
currently is no: there's no way to tell devtools how to resolve
non-cran dependencies.

Hadley
